metadata.title: Regulated Digital Service

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business Compliance Management – ensures institutional services operate in accordance with external regulation and internal policy obligations.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Regulated Digital Service – an architecture pattern establishing a normative compliance boundary for digital services subject to regulatory or policy oversight.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Records and Governance Data – includes regulated records, disclosures, and compliance evidence associated with digital services.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Accessibility Technologies – technologies and service capabilities supporting accessible digital service delivery.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Communication Technologies – platforms and services used to communicate with users or the public.

links.remarks: Authoritative institutional source for branding, identity, and official representation requirements.

links.text: Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA)
links.remarks: Primary legislative authority governing accessibility obligations for digital services in Ontario.

metadata.remarks: The Regulated Digital Service pattern defines non-security regulatory obligations applicable to digital services. It establishes compliance scope and assessability without embedding legal interpretation, design requirements, or procedural controls.

components.title: Regulatory Applicability Declaration
components.description: Affirms that the digital service is subject to external regulation or institutional policy obligations beyond security controls.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Failure to acknowledge or scope applicable governance or regulatory requirements.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit governance declaration and compliance scoping.

components.title: Branding and Institutional Representation
components.description: Ensures institutional branding and official representation obligations apply to the digital service.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Institutional policies govern branding and public communications.

components.title: Accessibility Compliance Obligation
components.description: Affirms that accessibility legislation applies across all digital service delivery channels.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exclusion of users through inaccessible digital service design.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Design assurance and accessibility conformance verification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Accessibility legislation (e.g., AODA) establishes mandatory requirements for digital services.

components.title: Assessable Regulatory Compliance
components.description: Ensures regulatory compliance is assessable through governance artifacts, attestations, and institutional oversight.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or evasion of compliance evidence.
